It acts as a migration utility that fetches existing Prometheus-compatible rules and transforms them so they can be imported or managed within Grafana's alerting system, enabling users to consolidate their monitoring rules into Grafana's native rule structure while maintaining compatibility with Prometheus-style rule definitions.

info.name: Grafana Route Convert Prometheus Cortex Delete Rule Group

items.docs: This API operation is used to delete a specific Prometheus rule group within Grafana's Cortex-based alerting system. It targets a rule group identified by both its namespace title and group name through the URL path parameters. When called with the DELETE HTTP method, it removes the entire rule group configuration from the specified namespace, effectively eliminating all alert and recording rules contained within that group from the Prometheus-compatible rules engine in Grafana.
